rule: The digest cut must render byte-identically to the full state: digest-state parity over real logs, team100 and the options matrix gates every change to what the cut keeps.
chose: Tighten the digest cache cut, DIGEST_CACHE_VERSION 1 → 2 (D-b, operator ruling 2026-09-24). The cut keeps per-session text only for the sessions renderStatus reads text from (open, last unwritten, the lane's recent, overlapping write-backs); every other session keeps only what counts, existence and order need.
